speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng
text: asked the Minister for Education with regard to the proposed Artificial Intelligence (AI) marking system for English subject assignments on the online Student Learning Space (SLS), what safeguards will be in place to ensure automated marking does not undermine the potential for students' writing to develop creativity, cadence, personality and flair.

speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
text: These help to strengthen their mastery over the basics of writing, which in turn allows them to devote more effort on more demanding aspects like creative expression.

speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
text: With the LFA(EL), our teachers have an additional tool to complement their professional practice, enabling them to further develop our students' writing skills.
